# Material icons

Source: https://github.com/google/material-design-icons/tree/master/src

Google Material Icons (24px, filled), Apache License 2.0. SVG path data converted to Android VectorDrawable in app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_action_*.xml.

Icons: volume_up, play_arrow, skip_previous, skip_next, volume_off, mic, fast_forward, fast_rewind, remove, chevron_right, grid_on.
